name: Klaviyo MCP
description: Gives agents Klaviyo marketing data over a remote OAuth MCP server or local PyPI server, to report on and create email campaigns, flows, and catalogs.

skills.name: Campaign Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, clones, updates, and sends campaigns, and estimates the number of recipients before a send.

skills.name: Performance Reporting
skills.description: Pulls campaign and flow performance reports and aggregates event data for a metric with query_metric_aggregates.

skills.name: Flow Management
skills.description: Lists flows, inspects flow messages and actions, finds flows triggered by a metric, list, or segment, and creates flows.

skills.name: Catalog Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, updates, and bulk-edits catalog items, variants, and categories, and creates back-in-stock subscriptions.
